architecture:
## Android architecture — Collections / Pockets / Playlists / Setlists

Everything below builds on what is already shipped: `data/collections/CollectionsStore` (main-thread-confined singleton with a `synchronized(lock)` + `StateFlow<State>` snapshot), `CollectionsCodec` (lossy per-element decode), `AppGraph` hand-rolled DI, `PdjJson.lenient`, the `PlayHistoryStore` durable-JSON idiom (temp+rename, `.bak` quarantine), Navigation Compose routes in `MainActivity.kt`, Preferences DataStore settings. No new frameworks; three new library deps (versions pinned in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`): `androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-process` (ON_STOP flush), `androidx.work:work-runtime-ktx` (daily AM sync + location poll), `com.google.android.gms:play-services-location` (fused provider). Compose DnD comes from the existing foundation (BOM 2025.01.00).

### Data flow
1. **User mutation** → `CollectionsStore` choke point (`addSong/addSongs/addAlbum/remove*`) → `mutate*` stamps `updatedAt` → `save()` bumps `membershipRevision` + `saveVersion`, snapshots the document (immutable data classes, cheap), hands it to `CollectionsDocumentWriter.write(doc, version)` on its single-thread executor (encode + atomic write off the caller's thread; a lower version arriving later is dropped) → `onChange?`, `onActivityBatch?`/`onActivity?` (→ `CollectionActivityStore.record`), `enqueueSourceWriteBack?` (→ `PlaylistWriteBack.enqueue` + `runSoon`). `ProcessLifecycleOwner` ON_STOP → `flushNow()` (invalidate-through-version barrier, then synchronous write) — identical ordering rule to iOS (`invalidate` BEFORE the inline write).
2. **Catalog refresh** → `CatalogRepository.state` collector in `AppGraph` → if `settings.syncConvertedPockets` → `collections.syncConvertedCollections(catalog.playlists)` (allowsPull + judge `Seen` gates) → then `favoritesSync`/`writeBack.runSoon()` if signed in.
3. **Apple Music (device-only path)**: `AppleMusicWebApi` is the ONLY class that speaks `api.music.apple.com`; it reads `settings.musicUserToken` + `musicKitDevTokenClient.cachedTokenOrNull()`. `PlaylistWriteBack` (device-local queue, never synced) and `FavoritesSyncService` are its consumers; `AMPlaylistSyncClient` talks to the Lambda (`RemoteEndpoints.url(AM_PLAYLIST_SYNC_BASE)`) sending the MUT per call (never stored server-side). `PlaylistAppleMusicSync` is app-scoped (one instance in `AppGraph`) so a second screen can never fork a concurrent sync.
4. **Listening pockets**: `PlayHistoryStore` (outcome fields) + `ListeningLocationStore` (opaque ctx) + `CollectionFlattener` (membership) → `ListeningPocketsService.flush` (fingerprint diff) → `ListeningPocketsClient` → results cache → `ListeningPocketsScreen`. Credentials come through a nullable seam `() -> Pair<String,String>?` the Recs area wires; unwired ⇒ inert, zero network.
5. **Selection/DnD**: `RowSelection` (app-scoped in `AppGraph`, one per process — Android is single-window) holds `scopeId`, `ids`, `selectModeScope`, `activeList` registration; `SelectionBar` and drop targets build a `SongTransfer`, run `SongDrop.acceptableIds` against `catalog.songsById`, and call `collections.addSongs(ids, target)` once.

### Threading model
- Store mutations stay synchronous under `lock` (callers are Compose event handlers on main); the ONLY expensive step — encode+write — moves to `CollectionsDocumentWriter` (one `Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor`, version-ordered). Reads for UI go through `state.collectAsState()`.
- Heavy derivations (realize over big source playlists, flattener, recently-added selection, per-collection sort/filter, dedupe plans) run in `withContext(Dispatchers.Default)` from `LaunchedEffect`/`produceState` keyed on `state.revision`/catalog revision; never inside a composable body (collections-sequencer-perf lesson).
- Network (Web API, Lambda, pockets) on `Dispatchers.IO` via OkHttp; services expose `StateFlow` for progress and single-flight guards (`isSyncing`, `isFlushing`, epoch counters) exactly as iOS.
- WorkManager: `AppleMusicAutoSyncWorker` (periodic 15 min tick → `AppleMusicAutoSync.isDue` pure check → `runFullPass`), `LocationPollWorker` (periodic, low power). Location callbacks hop to main before touching the store.

### Platform APIs
- Compose `Modifier.dragAndDropSource { … }` / `dragAndDropTarget` with `ClipData` (`application/vnd.pocketdj.songlist+json` + `text/plain`); `LocalClipboardManager` for copy/paste.
- Storage Access Framework `ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/zip")` with the explicit `.playlist.pdjcollection` name; `OpenDocument` importer; manifest `<intent-filter>` ACTION_VIEW on `application/zip`/`application/octet-stream` + `pathPattern` `.*\\.pdjcollection` → `MainActivity.onNewIntent` → `CollectionsImport.importAny(uri)` (content-routed; never claims every zip as "ours" beyond the extension pattern).
- `java.util.zip` for the zips; `kotlinx.serialization` JSON element API for the lenient PWA `items.json`.

Not touched by this area; no decision taken here.

Owner gate (salted CloudKit userRecordID hash) is N/A: favorites two-way sync on Android is the per-install opt-in toggle only; the shipped owner-seed is a separate opt-in defaulting OFF (integrity rule: never seed someone else's picks silently).
The 3-strike removal confirmation is indexer-side (iMac am-sync pending-removals.json); nothing to port — the client only ever sees the confirmed catalog.

Schema parity first: Android must carry `amSyncDirection`, `cleanOnly`, `recsEnabled`, `amPlaylistId` with iOS's per-type CodingKeys semantics (schemaVersion stays 7 — additive, no bump, because a bump would discard documents). Every later package depends on COL-1.
Batch choke points + the version-ordered off-main writer land before any multi-select/DnD UI, so a select-all add is ONE document write, ONE activity batch, ONE write-back resolution.

No CLVisit on Android: the pure `ListeningPlaceEngine` is ported bit-for-bit and fed by a dwell detector over low-power fused fixes; raw coordinates stay on device, default OFF, erased on disable, never backed up.

Listening-pockets credentials (rec-engine key + scoped profile id) are a nullable seam owned by the Recs/For You area; the pockets service ships inert and makes zero network calls until wired — the privacy gate doctrine.

packages.title: Android location source (fused low-power + dwell detection) + Settings rows + wiring
packages.goal: Implement ListeningLocationSource on Android: FusedLocationProviderClient low-power updates (5 min interval, 200 m displacement) plus a dwell detector that synthesizes LocationVisitSample (stationary ≥ 5 min within 150 m ⇒ visit with arrival/departure; movement fixes ⇒ hints), a periodic WorkManager poll for background coverage, permission flow (COARSE first; BACKGROUND as the 'Always' upgrade, Settings deep-link when denied), Settings ▸ Recommendations rows ('Use places & trips in pockets' under the pockets toggle, status, Always upgrade, 'Erase places & trips'), onDisabled wiring from the pockets service, settleContexts trigger after each ingest.
acceptance: Turning location ON requires pockets ON; turning OFF is never blocked and erases; pockets turning off turns location off.
DwellDetector emits a visit only after ≥ 5 min stationary within 150 m, closes it on a fix farther than radius + accuracy, and ignores fixes worse than 3 000 m as movement hints.
No coordinates are logged or uploaded; only plc_/trp_ ids reach the history/pockets layers (test the upload event built from a tagged play).
Permission denied ⇒ authorization 'denied' row with a Settings deep-link; nothing ingested.
emulator_steps: Grant location, toggle on; `adb emu geo fix -122.4 37.8` hold 6 min (or inject with time acceleration via the detector's clock seam), then `adb emu geo fix -122.3 37.9` → Settings rows show 'Location A' with a share; play a song → History event carries ctx place id (inspect the pulled play-history file).
packages.device_only: Real visit/trip formation (background fixes, Doze, battery) can only be judged on a device over days; emulator covers the pipeline with injected fixes.
